policies.title: Thailand: Thai ordinary-passport holders
policies.summary: Thai citizens are not foreign nationals subject to Thailand's foreign-national visa and TDAC requirement.
conditions: Citizenship classification only; it does not determine dual-nationality, passport issuance, exit controls, residence, work, transit, or admissibility.
A Thai citizen travelling on a foreign passport is outside this passport-nationality finding.

policies.title: Thailand: current 60-day ordinary-passport visa exemption
policies.summary: The current Consular Affairs schedule gives these ordinary-passport nationalities visa-exempt admission for tourism and short-term business engagements for up to 60 days.
conditions: For tourism and short-term business engagements only, with a stay not exceeding 60 days.

The current schedule is used because it remains linked by the 31 March 2026 Consular Affairs index. The 19 May 2026 revision notice says its changes begin only 15 days after a Ministry of Interior announcement appears in the Royal Gazette; recheck before travel.
TDAC must be submitted by non-Thai nationals up to three days before arrival; it is an arrival declaration, not a visa or ETA.
Does not establish work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special-document, border-pass, extension, repeat-entry, security, or discretionary-admission rights.

policies.title: Thailand: 14-day bilateral ordinary-passport visa exemption
policies.summary: Myanmar and Timor-Leste ordinary-passport holders have the listed 14-day bilateral visa-exemption route.
conditions: Maximum stay is 14 days.
For Myanmar, the schedule expressly limits the route to international airports.
TDAC applies to non-Thai arrivals and is not a visa or ETA.
No inference for work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special documents, border passes, extensions, repeat entry, or discretionary admission.

policies.title: Thailand: 30-day bilateral ordinary-passport visa exemption
policies.summary: Chile's ordinary-passport bilateral agreement provides a 30-day visa-exemption route.
conditions: Maximum stay is 30 days.
TDAC applies to non-Thai arrivals and is not a visa or ETA.
No inference for work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special documents, border passes, extensions, repeat entry, or discretionary admission.

policies.title: Thailand: 90-day bilateral ordinary-passport visa exemption
policies.summary: Argentina and Brazil ordinary-passport bilateral agreements provide a 90-day visa-exemption route.
conditions: Maximum stay is 90 days.
TDAC applies to non-Thai arrivals and is not a visa or ETA.
No inference for work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special documents, border passes, extensions, repeat entry, or discretionary admission.

policies.title: Thailand: 15-day ordinary-passport visa on arrival
policies.summary: The current Consular Affairs VOA schedule gives these ordinary-passport nationalities a 15-day visa-on-arrival route; entries with the concurrent 60-day exemption are classified under that easier route instead.
conditions: The schedule states a 15-day stay. It does not establish a nationality-wide electronic visa, ETA, or advance-visa requirement for these passports.

The current schedule is used because it remains linked by the 31 March 2026 Consular Affairs index. The 19 May 2026 revision notice says its changes begin only 15 days after a Ministry of Interior announcement appears in the Royal Gazette; recheck before travel.
Current national schedule alone does not establish ports, fees, passport-validity, accommodation, funds, onward-ticket, extension, or repeat-entry terms; verify these with Immigration before travel.
TDAC applies to non-Thai arrivals and is not a visa or ETA.
No inference for work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special documents, border passes, security, or discretionary admission.

policies.title: Thailand: foreign ordinary passports eligible to apply for Thai eVisa
policies.summary: The MFA says foreign nationals can apply for Thai eVisa worldwide except from inside Thailand. These passports have no easier nationality-wide route established by the current schedules above.
conditions: Applicant must be a foreign national located outside Thailand; the worldwide statement establishes availability of the electronic application route, not guaranteed issuance or admission.

The portal requires an online account, application, supporting documents and payment. The competent mission may seek further documents or interview the applicant; exact visa type, purpose, document and nationality checks remain case-specific.
TDAC applies to non-Thai arrivals and is an arrival declaration, not a visa or ETA.

This ordinary-passport visitor-route classification does not establish work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic/official/special-document, border-pass, fee, duration, port, extension, security, or discretionary-admission rights.

application.label: Thai eVisa official portal
steps: Apply from outside Thailand through the Thai eVisa portal.
Create an account, select the appropriate visa category, upload the required documents, and pay the stated fee.
Await the competent mission's decision and use the approval email as instructed for travel and Immigration inspection.
